---
name: creative-visual-design
description: Develop cohesive visual direction, art direction, color, typography, iconography, and brand expression for digital products.
---
# Creative visual design
- Establish audience, product personality, brand attributes, and visual references before styling.
- Create a visual concept with a restrained palette, typography pairing, icon style, and imagery direction.
- Use contrast and hierarchy to guide attention; ensure visual style never harms data readability.
- Use original or properly licensed assets; do not invent trademark endorsements or use unlicensed brand artwork.
- Keep iconography consistent and provide text labels when icons alone are ambiguous.
- Document visual decisions as reusable rules, not isolated mockup choices.
